why: The must_not item is an issue whose lines a build that breaks plain CSV would still meet. I checked whether any expect line catches that kind of build. Several do. Line 3 runs the CLI with no flag, `printf 'a,b\n1,2\n' | node bin/csv2json.js`, and it must print exactly `[{"a":"1","b":"2"}]` plus a newline. The same line also says tab input without the flag must stay one column. Line 4 says parse() with no separator argument must still split on commas. Line 5 says the existing 'parse' and 'cli' tests must pass. A build that broke plain CSV through the CLI, through parse()'s default, or by always splitting on tabs would fail line 3 or 4. So the issue does not fall into the must_not case.
